rules.name: SQL Injection - UNION SELECT Attack
rules.description: Detects classic UNION-based SQL injection targeting column and table enumeration.

rules.name: SQL Injection - Tautology Bypass
rules.description: Detects tautology boolean statements (e.g., OR 1=1, 'a'='a') used to bypass authentication.

rules.name: SQL Injection - Comment Syntax
rules.description: Detects SQL inline comments used to truncate queries or obfuscate keywords.

rules.name: SQL Injection - Time-Based Blind Delay
rules.description: Detects database execution delay functions used in inferential blind SQLi.

rules.name: SQL Injection - Stacked Query Injection
rules.description: Detects semicolon-delimited administrative SQL statements (DROP, ALTER, INSERT, UPDATE).

rules.name: SQL Injection - Malicious Boolean Logic
rules.description: Detects injected boolean operators chaining suspicious SQL conditions.

rules.name: SQL Injection - System Schema Enumeration
rules.description: Detects access to system tables (information_schema, sys.databases, sysobjects).

rules.name: Cross-Site Scripting - Script Tag Injection
rules.description: Detects opening and closing script tags including obfuscated casing and whitespace.

rules.name: Cross-Site Scripting - JavaScript Protocol URI
rules.description: Detects javascript: or vbscript: pseudoprotocol execution in href or src attributes.

rules.name: Cross-Site Scripting - Inline HTML Event Handlers
rules.description: Detects DOM event handlers (onerror, onload, onclick, onmouseover).

rules.name: Cross-Site Scripting - Dialog Execution Functions
rules.description: Detects JavaScript dialog invocation (alert, confirm, prompt).

rules.name: Cross-Site Scripting - Document Cookie Access
rules.description: Detects client-side attempts to read or exfiltrate session cookies.

rules.name: Cross-Site Scripting - Malicious HTML Tags
rules.description: Detects dangerous HTML tags frequently used for XSS (iframe, svg, embed, object).

rules.name: Path Traversal - Directory Climbing Sequences
rules.description: Detects recursive directory climbing sequences (../ or ..\).

rules.name: Path Traversal - Sensitive System Files
rules.description: Detects direct access to critical operating system files (/etc/passwd, win.ini).

rules.name: Forced Browsing - Backup & Editor Files
rules.description: Detects reconnaissance requests for backup files (.bak, .old, .swp, ~).

rules.name: CRLF Injection - HTTP Response Splitting
rules.description: Detects carriage return line feed injection with attempts to set cookies or headers.

rules.name: Command Injection - Shell Metacharacter Execution
rules.description: Detects piped or sequenced shell command executions.
